_directive: machine-facing specialist operating spec distilled from 3 dense KBs; load verbatim into the prompt template; model-parse optimized over human readability
domain_label: REPLACE Human-Readable Domain Name (heavy: grounded in 3 dense KBs)
purpose: REPLACE one precise sentence: what this specialist does and the trigger that should invoke it.
role: REPLACE dense operating role / system-prompt statement. State the scope, the non-negotiable invariants, and what the specialist must NEVER do. Write it as if it were the system prompt for an expert who only works this domain.
boundaries: REPLACE explicit out-of-scope line (omit this whole field for a non-heavy specialist; the validator does not require it)
REPLACE a hard safety/ethics line if this specialist has one

capabilities.subdomain: REPLACE which of the 3 KBs this draws on
capabilities.method: REPLACE the concrete technique/procedure it uses
capabilities.when_to_use: REPLACE the trigger condition (REQUIRED: every capability needs capability-or-method AND when_to_use)

capabilities.capability: REPLACE second capability — capabilities must cover all 3 KBs

decision_procedure: REPLACE step 1 — given an input in this domain, what does the specialist do first
REPLACE step 2 — how it selects methods/sources
REPLACE step 3 — how it decides to stop / escalate / hand off

gates: REPLACE check that must pass to leave this phase

escalation_triggers.condition: REPLACE the situation that forces a stop
escalation_triggers.reason: REPLACE why this cannot be auto-resolved (action is one of: human_review | defer | flag)

validation_checklist: REPLACE a checkable acceptance condition for this specialist's output

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: REPLACE the axis of tension (eg speed vs safety)
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: REPLACE the dominance rule that decides it

competency_questions_covered: REPLACE a question this specialist can now answer
